Other listings (Yelp)

The same store on the sites the AI assistants cite besides Google. Yelp is pulled for every store (2026-10-19). Apple Maps and Bing Places are not checked yet: Apple needs a MapKit key from the Apple Developer account and Bing needs access to the Bing Places account.

StoreGroupGoogleYelpGapYelp reviewsClaimedPhone matchesWebsite on YelpYelp listing

Gap is the Yelp rating minus the Google rating. Yelp ratings run lower everywhere, but a gap wider than a full star usually means unanswered Yelp reviews. "Not found" means no Yelp listing matched the store phone or street address; the store may have a listing under a different phone, or none.

How the score works

Points are computed, not all-or-nothing: a 4.0 rating earns half the rating points, a 60% reply rate earns 60% of the reply points. Rows marked Not checked are dropped from the denominator and the score is rescaled to 100.

GroupCheckPointsScoring
SetupName matches the standard listing name5"Jiffy Lube Oil Change" (the chain standard, like "Valvoline Instant Oil Change") or the plain sign name = 5; a name with a city, keyword or slogan added = 0
SetupPhone matches site5Exact after normalization
SetupAddress matches site5Street, city, state and ZIP compared separately; any difference = 0 with the diff shown
SetupWebsite link points to this store's page10Co-op store page or the corporate jiffylube.com page for this store number = 10 (JLI sets that link chain-wide, so it is not held against the store); co-op home page = 7; corporate home page = 4; wrong store number, unrelated site or missing = 0
SetupPrimary category is Oil change service10Full or 0. Read from the Google Maps profile (Outscraper), not the Places API, which often reports a broader type
SetupSecondary categories present3Full with 2 or more of: Car repair and maintenance service, Tire shop, Brake shop, Auto air conditioning service
SetupRegular hours set for all 7 days4Full or 0
SetupHoliday / special hours set3Special hours exist for the next US holiday. Google only shows special hours 7 days ahead, so this is Not checked until the week before a holiday
SetupAttributes filled3Proportional to filled out of 7; missing ones listed
SetupOwner description present and relevant33 if it mentions "oil change" and the town; 1 if present without those. Not checked when the pull cannot see it: Google shows the description only in the Search knowledge panel, so the audit never marks it missing
SetupServices list filled2Not checked until we have Business Profile manager access
SetupAppointment / booking URL set2Full if a booking or appointment link is on the listing
ActivityGoogle Posts in last 30 days64 or more posts = 6; 1 to 3 = 3; none = 0. Date of the last post shown
ActivityOwner photo uploaded recently4Not checked: Google does not expose photo upload dates
ActivityLogo and cover photo set21 point each
ActivityOwner share of top photos3Proportional: owner photos among the top 10 Google shows
ReputationGoogle rating10Linear from 3.5 (0 points) to 4.5 (10 points); gap to nearby competitor median shown
ReputationNew reviews in last 90 days7Store count divided by the nearby competitor median, capped at 1 (target 30 if no competitor data)
ReputationOwner reply rate6Proportional; all reviews and 1 to 3 star shown separately
ReputationOwner reply speed4Not checked: the review source does not give reply dates
ReputationService and town keywords in recent reviews3Share of last-90-day reviews mentioning oil change, quick, fast, tire, brake or the town; 20%+ = full, proportional below

Unscored flags shown on the scorecard: not verified, closed status, possible duplicate listing within 200 m (same name or phone). Not available yet: pin distance from the street address.

Sources: Google Places API (what Google shows publicly), the Outscraper Google Maps profile pull (category, description, posts, booking link, verified, logo), the scraped Google reviews, the competitor map, and the store data on jiffylubechicagoland.com. Refresh: node scripts/gbp-pull.mjs in the competitor-map project.
